export type Lesson = { id: string; ownerId: string; topic: string };

export function getLesson(
  actor: string | null,
  id: string,
  rows: readonly Lesson[],
): { status: number; body: unknown } {
  if (actor === null) {
    return { status: 401, body: { error: 'UNAUTHORIZED' } };
  }
  const lesson = rows.find((row) => row.id === id && row.ownerId === actor);
  if (lesson === undefined) {
    return { status: 404, body: { error: 'NOT_FOUND' } };
  }
  return { status: 200, body: { id: lesson.id, topic: lesson.topic } };
}
